svg.desc: Stack. What I reach for, grouped by where it sits in a system. Languages: Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, GNU Bash. Product: React, NestJS, Node.js, FastAPI, Flask, Prisma. Data: PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SQLite, Redis, MinIO, RabbitMQ. Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, K3s, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, GitLab, NGINX, Linux, Vagrant. Applied AI: PyTorch, OpenCV, Ollama, FAISS, YOLOv8, Bedrock. AWS: IoT Core, Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, Cognito, ECS Fargate, RDS, S3, Elastic Disaster Recovery. Identity & endpoint: Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune, BitLocker, ManageEngine
